name: World Bank Open Data
desc: Development indicators for 200+ economies: GDP, population, poverty, education, health and infrastructure, mostly annual from 1960.

name: FRED
publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
desc: Hundreds of thousands of economic time series: interest rates, inflation, employment, money supply and regional data.

name: IMF Data
desc: Balance of payments, government finance, exchange rates and the World Economic Outlook database.

name: OECD Data Explorer
desc: Comparable statistics for OECD members on productivity, taxes, wages, education, health and the environment.

name: ECB Data Portal
desc: Euro-area monetary, banking, exchange-rate and financial-market statistics.

name: SEC EDGAR
desc: Company filings including annual and quarterly reports with structured XBRL financial data.

name: Data.gov
desc: Catalog of hundreds of thousands of U.S. federal, state and local government datasets.

name: U.S. Census Data
desc: Population, housing, income and business statistics from the decennial census and American Community Survey.

name: Bureau of Labor Statistics
desc: Employment, wages, consumer prices (CPI), productivity and workplace statistics.

name: data.europa.eu
desc: The official portal for European open data from EU institutions and member-state portals.

name: Eurostat
desc: Harmonised statistics on the EU economy, population, regions, trade, energy and more.

name: data.gov.uk
desc: Datasets published by UK central government, local authorities and public bodies.

name: Office for National Statistics
desc: UK economy, population, labour market and wellbeing statistics.

name: Statistics Canada
desc: Canadian data tables on population, economy, health, housing and trade.

name: Open Government Canada
desc: Federal datasets from Canadian departments and agencies.

name: Open Government Data India
desc: Datasets from Indian ministries, states and departments on agriculture, health, economy and more.

name: data.gov.au
desc: Australian federal, state and local government open data.

name: UNdata
desc: Statistics from UN agencies on population, trade, energy, environment and development.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory
desc: Health indicators for WHO member states: mortality, disease burden, health systems and risk factors.

name: Our World in Data
desc: Cleaned, documented datasets and charts on health, poverty, energy, climate and long-run trends.

name: Gapminder Data
desc: Long-run country indicators on income, health and population behind the famous animated bubble charts.

name: IPUMS
desc: Harmonised census and survey microdata from around the world, across many decades.

name: NASA Earthdata
desc: Satellite and Earth-science data on atmosphere, oceans, land, ice and climate.

name: NOAA NCEI
desc: Historical weather, climate normals, ocean and geophysical data for the U.S. and the world.

name: Copernicus
desc: Earth observation data, including Sentinel satellite imagery and climate reanalysis.

name: GBIF
desc: Billions of species occurrence records from museums, surveys and citizen science.

name: Natural Earth
desc: Clean vector and raster map data at 1:10m, 1:50m and 1:110m scales. Ideal for thematic maps.

name: OpenStreetMap
desc: A collaborative map of the world: roads, buildings, points of interest and boundaries.

name: Kaggle Datasets
desc: Community-shared datasets with notebooks, discussion and usability ratings.

name: Hugging Face Datasets
desc: Text, audio, image and tabular datasets for machine learning, with dataset cards and a viewer.

name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
desc: Classic benchmark datasets used in teaching and research for decades.

name: OpenML
desc: Machine-learning datasets, tasks and benchmark results that can be compared reproducibly.

name: Google Dataset Search
desc: A search engine that indexes dataset descriptions published across the web.

name: Registry of Open Data on AWS
desc: Large public datasets (genomics, satellite imagery, weather) hosted for cloud analysis.

name: Zenodo
desc: An open repository where researchers publish datasets, software and papers with DOIs.

name: Harvard Dataverse
desc: Research data repository spanning the social sciences, health and humanities.

name: ICPSR
desc: Social and behavioural science survey data, with documentation and codebooks.

name: Dryad
desc: Curated research data underlying peer-reviewed publications, especially in the life sciences.

name: Wikidata
desc: A free knowledge graph of 100M+ items, queryable with SPARQL.

name: Common Crawl
desc: Petabytes of web crawl data collected since 2008. Used widely for language-model research.

name: NYC Open Data
desc: 311 requests, taxi trips, restaurant inspections, permits and thousands more city datasets.

name: Chicago Data Portal
desc: Transportation, public safety, budget, licences and environmental data for Chicago.

name: FiveThirtyEight Data
desc: The datasets and code behind years of data-journalism articles. Great practice material.
